items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: They had Charlie Parker, Lucky Thompson, Dexter Gordon, Leo Parker... The trumpets, they had me and Dizzy

ctx.x: Yeah, they messed with you. Anybody that don't know what they're doing will be hung... Many a musician... Like Dexter Gordon went back out there, but he didn't know what he was going back into. He thought that because he was Dexter Gordon, he was going to get everything that was coming to him. He got everything that was coming to him, all right. They put him in jail every time he turned around.

That's why I split from out there. I saw what was happening, and I'd say, "Well, gee, I ain't gonna be out here in this mess, playing... Let me get out of here." Because I wasn't doing anything bad, but I mean, what they thought was bad, it would be anything, you know.
